recentItems.title: Robert Pattinson & Lance Oppenheim on How Braveheart, Jerry McGuire & Dracula Inspired ‘Primetime’
recentItems.description:
Robert Pattinson and director Lance Oppenheim sit down with Fandango correspondent Nikki Novak to share fascinating details about how they created their upcoming Chris Hansen biopic, ‘Primetime’!  They talk about sipping Four Loko while drafting the script, what unique inspirations made Pattinson feel like he had cracked his character, and why ‘To Catch A Predator’ is such an incredibly singular and fascinating concept.  See ‘Primetime’ in theaters September 25!

US Release Date: November 4, 2026
Starring: Rammstein
Director: Paul Dugdale
Synopsis: Filmed across three sold-out nights at the 65,000-capacity Foro Sol, Rammstein - Live in Mexico City captures one of the defining performances of the band’s monumental five-year world stadium tour in a spectacular concert film directed by two-time Primetime Emmy® Award winner Paul Dugdale. Spanning 135 concerts and witnessed by six million fans around the world, the tour marked a major chapter in Rammstein's career. Two-time GRAMMY® nominees with audiences across the globe, Rammstein have brought German-language rock to major venues around the world -- combining colossal sound and live production on a scale entirely their own. Featuring 20 career-spanning songs, the film places audiences at the heart of a show where 20-metre-high flames and towering industrial architecture are matched by moments of genuine connection between the band and the crowd. From November 4, 2026, audiences worldwide can experience Rammstein - Live in Mexico City in cinematic 4K.
